svg.data-memory: 8 GB DDR4 (premium SKU 16 GB, up to 32 GB)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; SyncE (ITU-T); IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC. NOS integration is required to activate these, which the datasheet states with an asterisk against the whole timing block
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-macsec: MACsec on the backhaul uplinks, up to 120 km long-reach applications
svg.data-compliance-programme: OCP Accepted and TIP DCSG compliant
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in; 1PPS SMA in/out; 10MHz SMA in/out; ToD RJ45 in; BITS RJ48 in
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; Anatel
svg.data-nebs: NEBS GR-1089, GR-3108; NEBS GR-63; TP76200, GR-3108 Class 2 OSP (NEBS Level 3)

rect.data-members: gnss-ant pps-in pps-out mhz-in mhz-out bits tod

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not complete), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground)
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, STAT row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting). The table lists no yellow state for this lamp
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (all fan modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fan modules fail or no fan module present)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PWR row - Off (no power or shutdown), Solid Green (system power good), Blinking Green (system power good but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but CPU power fail), Blinking Yellow (system power fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-oob-left: HIG Management Port LED table, Left LED - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); the jack's two integrated lamps are led-a/led-b of common/rj45-ganged-eth@1, one placement; before the RJ45 sweep they were two separate placements because std/rj45-ganged@1 contracted none; led-oob-right: HIG Management Port LED table, Right LED - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two jack lamps do not share a vocabulary, which is why each keeps its own states here rather than a shared default
g.title: oob

g.data-description: the two 40/100G uplinks at the right-hand end, numbered 0 and 1 in their own run on a magenta band
g.title: qsfp-0

g.data-description: ports 20-27, the datasheet's '8 x 1/10/25G SFP28 ports', the four columns the faceplate paints yellow. The vendor numbers them 20-27 as a continuation of the SFP+ run rather than restarting, so the rel-pos values are 20-27; index-origin is 0 because the schema allows only 0 or 1 there

circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to THIS PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)

circle.data-states: off ok fail standby no-dc warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to THIS PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
